scene: You climb the radio mast lookout, overlooking three waiting city routes below.
picture: Flat side view along an elevated catwalk ground line. On the far left, a yellow night tram waits on tracks. The boy in a denim jacket with curly hair and glasses stands left-centre. In the centre sits a wooden rowing boat on canal water. On the far right is an open freight lift.
shown: a glowing yellow night tram parked on rooftop tracks on the far left
a wooden rowing boat moored at a rooftop canal sluice in the centre
an open metal freight lift cage with an illuminated call button on the far right
